description: Parked by the coordinator on 2026-09-21 under Trey's cap of two review-fix rounds; none is glaring. (1) src/openapi/input-invariants.ts: the body.file near-miss is computed only after the present.length === 1 early return, so a body.file string alongside a real --file file=PATH ships as a duplicate multipart text field the API rejects; compute the near miss before the early return. (2) src/core/errors.ts hintsForError: a matched rule returning [] (rate-limit rule with no cmd) no longer falls through to the transient fallback hint; latent, every caller passes cmd. (3) elv ws --dry-run now preflights the output target like elv call does; decide whether dry runs should skip preflight for both commands together. Downside of parking: none of the three loses data; (1) surfaces as a provider error instead of a local exit 2.
